source: Our own concept draft (earned-trust-pr-factory.md), written with an LLM before anyone read the branches. The team quoted these example findings in the build prompt and flagged them as not existing in the real diffs.

accusations.claim: A [ThreadStatic] UTF-8 buffer is reused across calls and can leak data between threads
`finally { reader.Depth--; }` can underflow the reader depth when an exception is thrown
DateTimeOffset is boxed and written as 0x92 followed by Ext 0x7f, changing the wire format
PipeReader with LZ4 decompression does not advance the reader on a partial frame
